scripts.db:rebuild: rm -rf prisma/migrations && npx prisma migrate reset --force && npx prisma migrate dev --create-only --name init && sleep 1 && mkdir -p prisma/migrations/$(date -u +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)_constraints && cp prisma/constraints.sql prisma/migrations/$(date -u +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)_constraints/migration.sql && npx prisma migrate reset --force
